actions.action: Merge paragraph versions, not complete documents
actions.mechanism: Causal version tracking distinguishes successive edits from concurrent edits without treating logical revision numbers as timestamps.
actions.implementation: Store immutable operations with paragraph ID, author/device ID, revision, causal context, and text. Maintain concurrent heads separately for each paragraph.
actions.check: Replay independent and same-paragraph edits in both arrival orders; require identical heads, preserved independent edits, and both conflicting originals.
actions.risk: Revision numbers alone cannot establish causality across devices.

actions.action: Keep deletion as an explainable conflicting version
actions.mechanism: A tombstone participates in causal merging instead of immediately erasing paragraph text or authorship.
actions.implementation: Record deletion against observed paragraph heads. Retain concurrent edit and deletion heads; present the edited text beside the deletion proposal.
actions.check: Delete a paragraph offline on one device and edit it on the other; both reconnect orders must expose the same unresolved conflict.
actions.risk: Hiding tombstoned paragraphs unconditionally would conceal concurrent edits.

actions.action: Separate paragraph placement from paragraph content
actions.mechanism: Independent placement metadata allows moving a paragraph without overwriting edits to its text.
actions.implementation: Assign fractional position keys; moves update a causal placement register. Break concurrent-placement ties by revision/device tuple, and equal-position ties by paragraph ID.
actions.check: Replay concurrent moves, including moves of edited paragraphs, in reversed orders; require identical ordering and exactly one occurrence of every visible ID.
actions.risk: Position keys grow; retain alternative placements for inspection.

actions.action: Make conflict resolution an attributed edit
actions.mechanism: Resolution explicitly supersedes reviewed versions while preserving their original text and author/device attribution.
actions.implementation: Display separate original variants and provenance. Save chosen or combined text as a resolution operation naming reviewed heads; retain originals.
actions.check: Deliver an unseen concurrent edit after resolution; it must remain a conflict rather than disappear beneath the resolution.
actions.risk: Combined text still needs an explicit resolver attribution.

actions.action: Exchange durable operations with resumable acknowledgments
actions.mechanism: Idempotent operation exchange tolerates reconnect order, duplicate delivery, and interruptions without an additional service.
actions.implementation: Use the existing synchronization path. Atomically persist local edits and outbox entries; request missing operation ranges and acknowledge only durably stored operations.
actions.check: Interrupt transfer before and after acknowledgment, then reconnect in reverse order; require complete operation sets without duplicated paragraphs or versions.
actions.risk: A highest-seen revision acknowledgment can incorrectly skip gaps.

actions.action: Compact history only behind explicit safety conditions
actions.mechanism: Both-device acknowledgment and conflict retention prevent cleanup from destroying evidence needed by a returning offline device.
actions.implementation: Checkpoint acknowledged state, including causal summaries and tombstones. Pin unresolved originals; never expire them merely because 48 hours elapsed. Store variants separately, not concatenated.
actions.check: Generate repeated 8 KB conflicts across 500 paragraphs, compact, and reconnect a stale device; verify originals, attribution, and deletions survive.
actions.risk: Paragraph limits do not bound accumulated history storage.

actions.action: Build deterministic replay and crash tests
actions.mechanism: Fixed operation histories and varied delivery schedules expose order-dependent merging and unexplained data loss.
actions.implementation: Seed A, B, C. Offline, device one edits A, deletes B, moves C; device two edits A and B. Replay both reconnect orders, duplicates, and restarts.
actions.check: Require identical canonical state: both A originals, B deletion/edit conflict, C moved once, and correct attribution. Add independent edits as a survival control.
actions.risk: Compare conflict evidence and metadata, not rendered text alone.
